GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 1 length. got off leaders back turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: For some distance passing the 800m raced tight between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 4-5l off, held up turn, Straightened Up well off in traffic, clear passing 200m still well off, hit line well late once clear # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re riding rounding the home turn, rdr stated after beginning awkwardly she was obliged to settle at the rear of the field. She said that she had to ride her mount along in the early stages to remain in contact with  the field, however, from near the 700m the gelding began to travel on the bridle. As a consequence, when another rnr failed to quicken as she had anticipated on entering the home straight her mnt became badly held up on the heels of another rnr, had to be checked and was unable to obtain clear running until the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 2 Lengths 3rd early 4th x 600m, kept Under Good Hold To The Turn in Clear Straightening Up , couldn't quicken - # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in, made contact, and became unbalanced. After passing the 800m, when racing keenly, had to be steadied to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down 5th 1x1 with cover 2 1/2 Lengths trav well To The Turn clear run home Outside 3rd @ 100m, Took over x shadows - # perfect run/ride
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn made slight contact with another runner when racing tight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat box seat 1 length off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, half off 200m kept on storng , no match late # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and brushed rnr. Was held up rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4-5l off, eased Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on well # even effort
Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 1 length off, eased Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on well # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Four Wide Settled Down 3 Wide 2nd 1/2 had no favours Out On A Limb to Straightening Up kept on tough to 200m Couldn'T Go On - Pace Suited Swoopers this # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down Four Wide 5th 3 Lengths Under Pressure x 600m, gone Turning for home - # struggled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.  Rdr reported that rounding the home turn, his mnt put in a number of awkward strides and following this did not feel comfortable in its action. He said for this reason he eased it down in the home straight.  A post race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.  Trainer  advised that the gelding will now be spelled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths held together same to straightening up into Narrow Lead x 300 flat @ 200 just couldn't finish off - # had its chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until the 700m.
